name: Houkago Mania Club ~Koi no Hoshii no~
original_name: 放課後マニア倶楽部 ～濃いの欲しいの～
source:
This game is similar to After School Love Club, it even has the same 12 girls and 3 guys. The main guy this time is one of the girl's brother. Instead of a lover, he wants a pet. He gets that by getting friendly with a girl then take advantage of her weakness for abnormal fun.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050209185814/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
